value.rationale: The Heawood Fano incidence graph is a canonical 3-connected det-extremal cubic bipartite building block in current two-homogeneous colouring theory. The fact that four available colours produce 2520 frozen states yet every mobile sector has the same seven-vertex tree shape (with precisely one three-colour centre) exposes a substantive rigidity/reconfiguration obstruction not captured by existence or 3-palette frozen counts. The finite domain is natural and exhaustively classified, not an arbitrary slice.
